paragraphs: Golang backend engineer with 5+ years at Druva in Pune, from August 2021 to present. The work is production-grade, fault-tolerant integrations and distributed services: concurrent workers (goroutines and channels), throttling-aware integration with third-party APIs, multi-region execution, and metrics-driven troubleshooting.

From September 2024 to February 2025 I also worked part-time, concurrent with Druva, as an Applied ML / LLM Engineer at Momentum Robotics in Pune. I fine-tuned LLMs for warehouse and FMCG robotic operations and integrated models with telemetry, sensor feeds, and inventory APIs via MCP, including query rephrasing and reranking for real-time task prioritization.
I am looking for backend and applied AI engineer roles at product companies and Big Tech.

roles.title: Software Engineer II
bullets: Designed and implemented an on-demand metadata hydration pipeline for cloud application backups across 9 regions and 525+ nodes. Metadata preparation moved off the backup critical path, removing wasted work on backups with no changed data and cutting API throttling. An ingestion layer, a Thanos-based control and orchestration plane, and regional workers process millions of backup tasks, saving about $64K per month in cloud infrastructure cost and shortening backup windows.

Contributed to redesigning the control plane from a monolithic architecture to microservices. With a team of two junior engineers, implemented the Backupset microservice, and worked on a multi-region control plane deployment.
Developed reusable libraries for configuration, feature flags, and service integrations, used by peer engineering teams.

Designed and built a scalable, multi-instance downloader service from scratch (low-level design on AWS). It ingests 6M+ job requests, fans out billions of calls to Microsoft Graph to fetch customer data, and hands processed data to change generation and first-level dedupe. Owned SLAs and throttling for resilient high-volume API integration.
Designed high-fidelity change-detection libraries for Druva's next-generation SaaS storage system.
Improved core storage throughput and stability for Exchange Online, Gmail, SharePoint, and OneDrive by optimizing caching, database connections, multi-threading, and locking.

roles.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Owned and implemented Microsoft Graph API adoption for Exchange Online, migrating 2,000+ customers (about 2 million devices) from Outlook REST and EWS APIs to Graph API. Backup success rate reached 99% and restore success rate reached 95%. Proactively evaluated APIs and third-party libraries to address data-loss risks before customer impact.

Owned the Exchange Online data path end to end as the primary point of contact for escalations, resolved high-priority customer issues, and built features that improved customer retention and POC success. Mentored 2 junior engineers to take over ownership.
Built a framework that automates provisioning of 58+ Dockerized services, with startup validation and inter-service dependency handling. Adopted organization-wide.
